events.summary: Deutsche Bank launched a crypto custody service in Germany and plans to expand it to Asia in 2027.

events.title: China Q3 GDP grows 4.5%, beating forecasts; September retail sales up 1.1%
events.summary: China's GDP grew 4.5% y/y in Q3 (poll 4.4%, Q2 4.3%) and 1.2% q/q; September retail sales rose 1.1% (poll 0.5%) and industrial output 5.5%, while Jan-Sep fixed-asset investment fell 7.2% and property investment 20.6%.

events.title: US import prices post largest annual gain in more than four years
events.summary: US import prices rose in September, posting their largest year-on-year increase in more than four years, adding to inflation pressure after the hot CPI print.

events.title: Strive buys $335 million of bitcoin, lifting holdings to 36,818 BTC
events.summary: Strive said it bought about $335 million of bitcoin, taking its holdings to 36,818 BTC.

events.title: Strategy buys 267 bitcoin at an average of about $82,900 in the week to October 18
events.summary: Strategy (MSTR) bought 267 BTC at an average price of about $82.9k in the week ended October 18 and repurchased preferred shares, its weekly update showed.

events.title: Saudi Arabia to postpone in-person 'Davos in the Desert' after Houthi attacks
events.summary: The FT reported Saudi Arabia will postpone the in-person Future Investment Initiative after Houthi attacks; Fars separately reported sirens and an explosion in Riyadh the same hour.

events.title: MARA sends $82.8 million of bitcoin to exchanges
events.summary: Bitcoin miner MARA moved about $82.8 million of bitcoin to exchanges in October, signalling possible sales.

events.title: MSCI finalizes non-operating company rules that put Strategy and crypto treasury firms at risk of index exclusion
events.summary: MSCI adopted its framework for screening non-operating companies (core operating-asset test plus five financial ratios), which could remove Strategy (MSTR), Metaplanet and similar bitcoin treasury firms from its Global Investable Market Indexes; the affected list is due Nov 11 with changes effective Dec 1. JPMorgan has previously estimated an exclusion could trigger about $2.8 billion of passive MSTR selling.

events.title: Asian AI stocks crash: Kospi plunges about 8% triggering circuit breaker, Nikkei down about 5%
events.summary: After the hot US CPI, Korea's Kospi fell as much as 8.2% to 5,514.96, triggering a 20-minute circuit breaker (its 10th this year), while the Nikkei fell about 5% as AI and chip stocks tumbled amid AI financing worries including CoreWeave debt concerns.

events.title: Deutsche Bank prepares crypto custody launch, targets Asia growth
events.summary: Reuters reports Deutsche Bank is preparing to launch its crypto custody service and is targeting growth in Asia.

events.title: CME launches Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures
events.summary: CME Group set October 19 as the start of Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures, its tenth and eleventh single-asset crypto futures, in standard and micro sizes.

events.title: Google to allow certified crypto exchange and wallet ads in the UAE from October 21
events.summary: Google said that from October 21, 2026, crypto exchange, wallet, CFD and forex advertisers in the UAE may run ads if Google-certified.

events.title: Longest chip selloff since 2006 hands short sellers $32 billion; Nasdaq falls 2%
events.summary: Chip stocks extended their longest losing streak since 2006, giving short sellers about $32 billion in paper gains, while the Nasdaq fell about 2% on Friday as doubts over AI returns deepened; chip-equipment stocks also posted historic losing streaks.

events.title: Japanese banks complete joint stablecoin issuance
events.summary: A group of Japanese banks completed a joint stablecoin issuance.

events.title: South Korea considers delaying crypto tax as five exchanges meet officials
events.summary: South Korean officials are considering postponing the planned crypto tax after meeting the country's five main exchanges.

events.title: South Korea's FSS says new crypto oversight framework talks near completion
events.summary: South Korea's FSS governor said talks with the Financial Intelligence Unit on a new crypto oversight framework are near completion, as regulators meet exchanges amid calls to delay crypto taxation.

events.title: CoreWeave jumps on Goldman Sachs upgrade as AI stocks rebound; Nasdaq up over 1%
events.summary: CoreWeave shares jumped after a Goldman Sachs upgrade and AI-linked stocks recovered, lifting the Nasdaq more than 1% ahead of key earnings; Marvell rose 6% and Broadcom 3%.

events.title: Bitcoin drops below $81,000 with nearly $1 billion of crypto liquidations; spot ETFs see $261M outflow
events.summary: Bitcoin fell about 3.6% to roughly $80,764 in Asian trading as risk-off spread from Korean and Japanese equities; nearly $1 billion of crypto positions were liquidated and US spot bitcoin ETFs posted $261.46 million of net outflows.

events.title: Russia to ban direct person-to-person crypto trades from July 2027
events.summary: The Moscow Times reported Russia will ban direct person-to-person cryptocurrency trades from July 2027.

events.title: Sensex falls 876 points to 73,852 and Nifty closes at 22,888 as banks and crude weigh
events.summary: The Sensex closed down 876 points at 73,852 and the Nifty fell 257 points (1.1%) to 22,888, led by private banks such as Axis Bank and HDFC Bank, with weak earnings and high crude cited.

web.title: XDC top story
web.takeaway: CoinMarketCap said XDC's dip from $0.0334 to $0.0316 tracked a broad market sell-off, with no hacks, outages or delistings reported.
